findings.problem: Saying that adding "ay" to "different" gives you the word suggests the spelling "differente" with a double f and an "ay" ending, but the Spanish has one f and ends in a short "eh" sound.
findings.fix: trick: DIFERENTE is just "different" with one f dropped and an "eh" added at the end: dee-feh-REN-teh.

back.example: This city is very different from mine.

note: The hint is needed because distinto is also a common right answer, and it correctly rules distinto out.
